instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a dry grassy field under a clear blue sky, the woman in the shearling-lined denim jacket (R1) stands on the left, playfully kicking her left leg up high while smiling. The man in the denim jacket (R2) stands on the right, holding her hand and smiling down at her leg. They hold hands in the center. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene with warm tones and soft shadows, creating a joyful, sunny atmosphere.
